ch0098_90_hau/0101_0701_01_10:
Alola, [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
Glad to see you today!
ch0098_90_hau/0101_0701_02_10: Let’s eat, then have a battle!
ch0098_90_hau/7101_0701_01_10:
Feeling the same way as my partner
Pokémon, our hearts in sync...
ch0098_90_hau/7101_0701_02_10:
I started doing that when I was back
in Alola.
ch0098_90_hau/7101_0701_03_10:
I’m surprised the same thing’s needed
to awaken one’s arc suit!
ch0098_90_hau/7102_0701_01_10:
To get stronger with your partner Pokémon,
you need to do more than just battle.
ch0098_90_hau/7102_0701_02_10:
Eating together, playing together...
There are lots of ways to deepen your bond!
ch0098_90_hau/7102_0701_03_10:
I wanna enjoy a bunch of things with my
partner so we can be even better friends!
ch0098_90_hau/7103_0701_01_10:
On Alola’s Melemele Island, people go all
out in battles dedicated to our guardian
deity!
ch0098_90_hau/7103_0701_02_10:
It’s our way of thanking the guardian deity
for standing by us and protecting us.
ch0098_90_hau/7103_0701_03_10:
It makes me wonder if Arceus awakened my
arc suit because it was pleased with my
battling!
ch0098_90_hau/7104_0701_01_10:
Since we arrived on Pasio, everyone from
Alola’s gotten way stronger!
ch0098_90_hau/7104_0701_03_10: We’ll keep pushing forward at full power!
ch0098_90_hau/7105_0701_01_10:
Hey, [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
Are you a good cook?
ch0098_90_hau/7105_0701_02_10:
I’ve been thinking homemade pancakes could
help me become even better buddies with
Raichu.
ch0098_90_hau/7105_0701_03_10: I want ’em to be just as good as my mom’s!
ch0098_90_hau/1701_0701_01_10: Ho! Perfect timing! I have something for you!
ch0098_90_hau/1701_0702_02_10:
The more fun you have, the more you can
achieve!
ch0098_90_hau/2501_0701_01_10:
In Alola, we have guardian deities called
the tapu...
ch0098_90_hau/2501_0701_02_10: so I’m pretty familiar with deities.
ch0098_90_hau/2501_0701_03_10:
Between Arceus and the tapu, I wonder
who’s greater.
ch0098_90_hau/2501_0702_01_10:
Do you think Arceus likes malasadas and
pancakes, too?
ch0098_90_hau/2501_0702_02_10:
If it likes the same foods as Raichu, I’m sure
it’d be easy to get along with!
ch0098_90_hau/2511_0701_01_10:
Even though I was recognized by Arceus,
my biggest goal is still to be like my gramps.
ch0098_90_hau/2511_0701_02_10:
Maybe it’s because I’ve followed in his
footsteps since I was little.
ch0098_90_hau/2511_0702_01_10:
Being so close to my goal sure lights a fire
under me!
ch0098_90_hau/2511_0702_02_10:
If you have a goal you’re working toward,
let’s see who can reach theirs first!
ch0098_90_hau/3001_0701_01_10:
I can’t decide what to have for breakfast
today—pancakes or malasadas!
ch0098_90_hau/3003_0701_01_10:
If we all eat and battle together, I’m sure
we’ll become even closer friends!
ch0098_90_hau/3005_0701_01_10:
When you go all out having fun, you gotta
go all out sleeping, too! Then you’ll be
ready for another fun day!
